decks.name: LeetCode #238 - Product of Array Except Self
decks.description: Return an array where each element is the product of all other elements except itself

cards.question: Product of Array Except Self: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i]. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time and without using the division operation.

solutions.name: Prefix and Suffix Optimal
solutions.explanation: Use the output array to store prefix products in first pass, then multiply by suffix products in reverse pass. This achieves O(n) time with O(1) extra space by reusing the output array. Most space-efficient solution.

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time where n is the length of the array. We make two passes through the array.
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant extra space beyond the output array. The prefix and postfix variables use O(1) space. Output array of O(n) is not counted as extra space.
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given [1,2,3,4]: First pass (prefix): res=[1,1,2,6] (prefix starts at 1, then 1, then 1*2=2, then 1*2*3=6). Second pass (postfix): postfix starts at 1. At i=3: res[3]=6*1=6, postfix=1*4=4. At i=2: res[2]=2*4=8, postfix=4*3=12. At i=1: res[1]=1*12=12, postfix=12*2=24. At i=0: res[0]=1*24=24, postfix=24*1=24. Result: [24,12,8,6].

solutions.name: Prefix and Suffix Arrays
solutions.explanation: Create separate arrays for prefix and suffix products. The result at each index is the product of its prefix and suffix values. Clear approach but uses extra O(n) space for the prefix and suffix arrays.

semanticLines: Define function productExceptSelf that accepts array nums.
Get length of nums and store as n.
Create array pref of n zeros for prefix products.
Create array suff of n zeros for suffix products.
Set pref at index zero to one as base case.
Set suff at index n minus one to one as base case.
Loop through indices from one to n.
Get nums at i minus one, multiply by pref at i minus one, store in pref at i.
Loop through indices from n minus two down to zero.
Get nums at i plus one, multiply by suff at i plus one, store in suff at i.
Create array res by iterating through indices and multiplying pref at i by suff at i for each index.
Return res.
codeLines: res = [pref[i] * suff[i] for i in range(n)]

solutions.name: Division
solutions.explanation: Calculate the total product of all non-zero elements, then divide by each element to get the result. Handle zero cases specially: if more than one zero exists, all results are zero; if exactly one zero, only that position gets the product. Not allowed in problem constraints but shown for understanding.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: For each position, calculate the product of all other elements using nested loops. Skip the current index when multiplying. Least efficient but most straightforward approach.
